description: This file defines a C# class for an Orleans grain that subscribes implicitly to a stream with a specific namespace predicate, handles stream events, and provides a method to retrieve a counter of received events.

classes.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionWithExtensionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that subscribes to a stream with implicit subscription, handles incoming stream events, and maintains a counter of received events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to activate the grain, set up stream subscription, and handle incoming stream events.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current count of received stream events.
